name: 78118 · Karnes City, TX
findings: ZIP 78118 (Karnes City) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78118 (Karnes City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
